description: This file defines a class for configuring account journals within an Odoo module, including methods for retrieving and setting default journal accounts, and handling user interface actions.

classes.name: Journal
classes.description: A class for managing journal configuration in Odoo, including default account retrieval and UI actions.

methods.name: _get_journal
methods.description: Retrieves the current journal based on internal step state.

methods.name: _get_debit
methods.description: Retrieves the default debit account for the current journal.

methods.name: _get_credit
methods.description: Retrieves the default credit account for the current journal.

methods.name: on_change_debit
methods.description: Updates the default debit account for a journal when changed.

methods.name: on_change_credit
methods.description: Updates the default credit account for a journal when changed.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Handles cancel action, returning to configuration wizard.

methods.name: action_new
methods.description: Advances to the next journal or marks completion.
